scenarios.scenario_abstract: Preparing for a full session targeting gilthead seabream from Alexandria's rocky shore and small jetties, [X] expects salt spray, mild surf, wet bait, slippery stone, and occasional rain and needs the feet to remain dry and stable from early setup through packing the catch and tackle away.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 准备在亚历山大的岩岸和小码头整段垂钓金头鲷时，[X]从清晨架设装备到最后收拾渔获与钓具，都要面对海水飞溅、轻微浪涌、湿饵、湿滑石面和偶发降雨，因此需要双脚持续保持干燥与稳定。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Based in Ginowan with family, [X] keeps elementary-age children active through four lightly rainy days by moving among indoor sports, hands-on museums, craft workshops, an aquarium, and a covered cave complex, with only short walks between the car and each venue and enough flexibility to avoid muddy outdoor equipment.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 与家人住在宜野湾时，[X]要让小学生在连续四个小雨天保持兴趣，于是在室内运动、互动博物馆、手作工坊、水族馆和有遮蔽的洞穴园区之间安排轻松行程，只需应对停车处到场馆之间的短时淋雨，并避开泥泞的户外设施。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While following an organic year-round care cycle for old peach and apple trees, [X] sprays bare branches until liquid drips, times treatments around dry windows, rakes diseased leaves, and collects every damaged fallen apple from damp ground without carrying spray residue and moisture through the rest of the home.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 按全年有机方案养护老桃树和苹果树时，[X]会把裸枝喷到液体滴落，围绕连续干燥窗口安排处理，清扫病叶，并从潮湿地面及时捡走每个受损落果，同时避免把喷液残留和水分带进家中其他区域。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Living with family in an earthquake- and typhoon-prone area, [X] adds flood preparation after documenting standing water at the nearby drain, clears an elderly family member's route, stages sandbags and medication, and checks the safe dry edge of the property during heavy rain without treating protective clothing as permission to enter floodwater.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 与家人住在地震和台风多发地区时，[X]在记录附近排水口积水后补充洪水预案，清理老人撤离通道，预置沙袋与药物，并在暴雨中只从安全、较干的一侧检查住宅边缘，绝不把防护穿着当作可以进入洪水的理由。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While cycling regularly in a hilly city for both daily commuting and rides with the children, [X] prepares for unavoidable rainy journeys by checking brakes and tires, choosing low-traffic routes, managing wheel spray and puddles, and staying dry enough to avoid cold wet feet through climbs, stops, and the return leg.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在丘陵城市日常骑车通勤、也会带孩子骑行时，[X]面对无法避开的雨天行程，需要检查刹车和轮胎、选择低车流路线、应对车轮喷溅与水洼，并在爬坡、停车和返程全过程中避免双脚因持续湿冷而失去舒适与安全。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: During a weekend at a lake campsite, [X] moves among the shoreline, cooking area, quiet walks, and a low-light stargazing spot. When the weather turns, [X] keeps the routine workable by securing shelter, preserving a dry clothing reserve, and crossing wet grass and soft ground without soaking through.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在周末湖边营地中，[X]会在岸线、炊事区、安静散步路线和低光观星点之间活动；天气转坏时，则通过加固帐篷、保留干燥衣物和安全穿过湿草地与松软地面，使原有安排仍能继续，同时避免双脚被浸湿。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a five-day Hurghada trip built around affordable snorkeling and beach time, [X] repeatedly moves among boat deck, shallow water, reef entry, sand, and a dry promenade, accepts that footwear will get wet, and prioritizes drainage, low water retention, and fast drying before the next land activity.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在五天的赫尔格达经济型行程中，[X]会反复往返于船甲板、浅水区、礁石入水点、沙滩和干燥步道，主动接受鞋履进水，并把排水快、少蓄水和能在下一段陆地活动前迅速干燥放在首位。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a September Iceland route linking waterfalls, black-sand coast, geothermal stops, and one quiet night at a designated nature campsite, [X] proceeds only after checking weather and safe boundaries. Cold rain, waterfall mist, wet tracks, and hours outdoors require dry feet without encouraging cliff, river, or surf exposure.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在九月把瀑布、黑沙海岸、地热地点和正规自然营地的一晚独处串成冰岛路线时，[X]只会在核对天气和安全边界后行动；冷雨、瀑布水雾、湿路和长时间户外停留要求双脚保持干燥，同时绝不靠近悬崖、河流或浪区冒险。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: With EUR 2,000 for a long summer of Norwegian fjord camping, [X] travels by foot and public ferry among coastal camps, snowmelt waterfalls, long trails, and marshy berry ground and prepares for several consecutive wet days rather than assuming midnight sun guarantees dry conditions.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 用 2000 欧元完成较长的挪威峡湾夏季露营行程时，[X]会依靠步行和公共渡轮穿行于海岸营地、融雪瀑布、长距离步道和湿软浆果地，并按可能连续数日降雨来准备，而不把午夜太阳误当成干燥天气保证。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: With a partner, [X] keeps a late-April Table Mountain hike conditional on a same-day clear, low-wind, rain-free check, plans to take the cable car down, and switches to a sheltered city plan if rock is wet. Their ordinary walking only needs to tolerate a passing autumn shower, not justify continuing onto a slippery route.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]和伴侣把四月底的桌山徒步严格建立在当天晴朗、低风、无雨的检查结果上，计划乘缆车下山，并在岩面潮湿时改做有遮蔽的城市活动；普通步行只需应对短暂秋雨，不能把防水能力当作继续走湿滑路线的理由。
